title: A Quiet Place to Call Home
transcript: My neighbour Martin used to put a dish of water outside his front door for birds. During a dry summer, I copied him and put a dish on my balcony. For the first week, I saw no birds at all. Martin told me to move the dish away from the doorway, where people often walked past. By the following morning, two small birds were drinking from it. I still change the water every day before breakfast.

questions.prompt: What happened during the first week?
options: No birds came to the dish.
questions.answer: No birds came to the dish.
questions.explanation: I saw no birds at all 对应最初一周没看到鸟。

questions.prompt: Why did Martin suggest moving the dish?
options: The dish got too little sunlight.
Rain could fill it too quickly.
The balcony was hard to clean.
questions.explanation: 马丁让说话者把水盘移离经常有人经过的门口。
